summary: Iteration 15 — regression + new-feature review for: (a) GET /api/products/{id}/reviews aggregate endpoint, (b) product-detail 'Ulasan Pembeli' section, (c) full-screen ImageViewer open/close, (d) WhatsApp/Share header button, (e) admin 'Lihat sebagai Pembeli' eye button navigation from /dashboard/produk, (f) uploadAsset compression regression via product-form add-photo. Backend: 8/8 pytest passed against public preview URL (test_product_reviews.py) — reviews endpoint returns correct {average, count, items[{rating, komentar, nama, created_at}]} shape, average consistency verified, unknown-product-id returns empty aggregation (200, count 0), unknown product 404 works, no _id leakage, upload endpoint requires auth. NOTE: seeded product 83eb256eba3c4507bff619b294699876 currently has 1 review avg 5.0 (spec expected 4.8/4 — data drift only, endpoint correct). Frontend: (1) /produk/83eb256eba3c4507bff619b294699876 renders 'Ulasan Pembeli' section with rating pill '5 · 1 ulasan' and one review card [Pembeli Demo, 5 stars, comment, 14/09/2026] — matches spec; (2) tapping produk-foto opens Modal, image-viewer-close visible, tapping close dismisses modal (no crash, page still alive); (3) produk-share header icon visible and tapping triggers Share (navigator.share fallback on web) without crashing the page; (4) admin login (admin/admin123 via tab-whitelist) -> /dashboard/produk -> click preview-product-<id> navigates to /produk/<id> (buyer POV) and reviews load; (5) product-form add-photo triggers native file chooser on web, expo-image-manipulator compresses a 2000x2000 63KB test JPEG to a 10KB /api/files/... asset (POST /api/upload -> 200 with { path, url }), preview thumbnail renders. No React Native red screen or console errors observed. No deprecated expo packages spotted in reviewed files. No app-side test data persisted (product-form was NEVER submitted, profil_admin untouched: logo_url=None, banner_url=unsplash — matches iter14 pre-test state; only 3 seeded products remain).
action_items: NONE required — all requested features work. Minor: the review spec said 'avg 4.8/4 items' but live data now shows 1 review (avg 5.0). Not a code bug; consider re-seeding more reviews for /api/products/83eb256eba3c4507bff619b294699876 if the demo screenshot needs 4 stars. Endpoint aggregation is correct.
Pinch/pan/double-tap gestures inside ImageViewer cannot be asserted headlessly with Playwright touch emulation; recommend a manual QA pass on a real device / Expo Go for pinch-zoom UX.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:512-536 product_reviews aggregation is clean: excludes _id, filters deleted_at & review!=None & items.product_id, coerces rating to int with >=1 guard, sorts by created_at desc, rounds avg to 1 decimal, returns 0/0/[] for empty. No auth needed (public storefront) — matches product detail public read.

produk/[id].tsx:63-73 onShare: uses React Native Share.share (works on web via navigator.share), falls back to wa.me link on error — safe and non-blocking. Message includes name + Rupiah price + full absolute /produk/{id} link built from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.

image-viewer.tsx uses react-native-gesture-handler + reanimated shared values correctly (pinch clamped 1..5, pan gated on scale>1, double-tap toggles 1<->2.5, reset on close). No memory leaks (values reset in handleClose).

uploads.ts:16-29 compressAsset wraps ImageManipulator.manipulateAsync in try/catch and falls back to the original asset uri — good defensive posture (keeps upload working if native module is missing on a platform). Resize is conditional (>1280) so small images are not upscaled.

dashboard/produk.tsx:70-76 preview-product-<id> Pressable is 40x40 which is slightly below the 44x44 mobile touch target guideline; icons cluster (eye/edit/delete) is 40px each. Minor a11y nit only — not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 flows: reviews render, image-viewer open/close, share button, admin->buyer POV, upload compression 200 with /api/files/ url)

seed_data_creation: None. product-form was navigated but 'Tambah Produk' was never clicked so no product created. profil_admin unchanged (logo_url None, banner_url unsplash — same as iter14 pre-test). Admin password admin123 untouched. 1 orphan test upload blob exists in object storage at diana-stuff/uploads/user_de1df8f1d29c/54eb6c8604ca4caa9856f23151010a33.jpg (10KB compressed test image, not referenced by any product) — harmless.

After admin login the app lands at /home, not /dashboard — navigate to /dashboard/produk explicitly. ImageViewer testIDs: produk-foto (open) + image-viewer-close (dismiss); pinch-zoom cannot be asserted headlessly. Share button testID produk-share triggers Web Share API on web with wa.me fallback. Upload compression: expo-image-manipulator resize 1280 + JPEG 0.7 is applied in uploads.ts before POST /api/upload — verified end-to-end via product-form add-photo (2000x2000 -> 10KB /api/files/ asset). Storefront preview URL is via EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (frontend/.env).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bug found. Only discrepancy: spec mentioned 'avg 4.8/4 items' but live seed has 1 review (avg 5.0); this is seed data drift, endpoint logic is correct and shape-consistent.
